purpose: Test whether an independently defined upward price context improves the existing green PE-OI-fall / VIX-rise bubble observations.
input: BUBBLE_RESEARCH_INPUTS_V1 from the supplied minute(1).zip; minute-spaced option-report spot/VIX observations, not exchange one-minute OHLC closes

context.formula: s = t - 5 minute slots; E = (P[s] - P[s-30]) / sum(abs(diff(P[s-30:s]))); A = mean(P[s-29:s]); BULLISH iff E >= 0.30 and P[s] > A and P[t] > A
context.missingOrInvalidPrices: UNKNOWN; require all 36 consecutive minute slots with positive prices, ordered receipts and gaps <= 90 seconds
context.bearish: Symmetric E <= -0.30, P[s] < A and P[t] < A; otherwise MIXED
context.sensitivityPurpose: Robustness only; do not select a replacement threshold on these outcomes

bubble: Unchanged BASIC_OTM_OI_VIX_V2 green PE_UP event: at least one of nearest three strict OTM puts has one-update OI fall >=1% and >=3x median absolute percentage OI change over prior 20 updates; report VIX rises >=0.4% over five minute slots

primary.phase: Signal before 15:15 IST, consistent with the previous study's continuous-session boundary
primary.case: BULLISH context and unchanged green bubble
primary.deduplication: First qualifying case, then require at least 15 minute slots since the last selected case, separately each session
primary.subgroups: P[t] > P[s]: PRICE_UP_WITH_VIX; P[t] < P[s]: PULLBACK_WITH_VIX; equality: FLAT_WITH_VIX
primary.horizonEligibility: Recorded consecutive positive report prices; endpoint before 15:15 IST; future prices used only in outcome evaluation

controls.eligibility: Same primary price context, continuous-session time, no green bubble at this report; valid six-slot VIX history and computable prior OI history for all three current near-OTM puts
controls.sameVix: Second pool additionally requires VIX rise >=0.4% over the same five-slot window
controls.matching: Same session, IST clock hour, and sign of the five-slot price change. Average all eligible controls in that stratum for each case; give every matched case equal weight. Do not use future outcomes to choose controls.
controls.unmatched: Retain and report; never substitute another day/hour or direction
controls.interpretation: Observational comparison, not randomized or causal; control windows may overlap

optionTest.position: BUY nearest strict OTM CE at signal-time spot, same expiry; keep that contract fixed
optionTest.entry: Next minute's first recorded LTP (bar open); gross indicative execution proxy
optionTest.policy: Reuse OI_VIX_OUTCOMES_V1 without alteration: reject bad entry bars or premium <=20; censor at first missing/flagged bar; retain both-hit ambiguity; stop gaps may exceed 20; cap at target; stop reading at 15:40 IST
optionTest.costs: Excluded: spread, slippage, brokerage, taxes and latency
optionTest.portfolio: Independent observations; options may remain open across later signals

reporting.primary: Episode cases, raw and matched 5/10/15-minute index changes, full option outcome categories
reporting.secondary: All green bubbles and all bullish green bubbles, day breakdown, both price-response subgroups, threshold sensitivity, late-session/unknown exclusions
reporting.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals for matched index differences, resampling the 15 sessions as clusters, 2000 replicates, fixed seed 20260912
reporting.chronology: First 10 sessions versus last 5 as a stability check, explicitly not an untouched holdout because the archive was used earlier
reporting.limitations: 15 supplied sessions only; retrospective research, no demonstrated trading edge or parameter optimality

excludedInputs: VIX or OI inside the price-context classifier
full-day high/low computed using future observations
constituent breadth unavailable in these inputs
